detail.title: 4MP WizMind Dual-Lens Stereo Analysis Network Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite IPC-HDW8441X-BV-3D 4MP WizMind Dual-Lens Stereo Analysis Network Camera Key Points • High-Quality Imaging with 4 MP Resolution • Built-in Mic & Speaker: Secure Real-Time Talk • Binocular Stereo Vision and Deep Learning Algorithms for Improved Detection Accuracy • Supports 8 Types of Behavioral Analysis Event Detection • Privacy Protection Supports Auto-masks Faces or Bodies with Mosaic for Privacy • Supports Height Self-adaptation and Height Filtering • Built-in IR LED, the Max. Illumination Distance is 20 m • IP67 and IK10 Protection Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Min. Illumination: 2.0 mm: 0.005 lux@F2.0 (Color,30 IRE) 0.0005 lux@F2.0 (B/W,30 IRE) 0 lux (Illuminator on) 2.8 mm: 0.005 lux@F1.6(Color, 30 IRE) 0.0005 lux@F1.6 (B/W, 30 IRE) 0 lux (Illuminator on)
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Tripwire; intrusion; fast moving (the three functions support the classification and accurate detection of vehicle and human); parking detection; people gathering; loitering detection; privacy protection
General.Stereo Analysis: Crossing warning line; warning area intrusion; running detection (only supported by inclined mount cameras); people approaching detection; violence detection (including fighting and smashing); fall detection; abnormal number of people detection; people stay detection; privacy protection; height filtering
General.Smart Search: Work together with Smart NVR to perform refine intelligent search, event extraction and merging to event videos.
General.Video Compression: H.265; H.264; H.264H; H.264B; MJPEG (Only supported by the sub stream)
General.AI Coding: AI H.265; AI H.264 *Includes smart codec technology, Smart H.265+ and Smart H.264+
General.Video Frame Rate: Main stream: 2688 × 1520@(1–25/30 fps) sub stream: 1920 × 1080@(1–25/30 fps) third stream: 1920 × 1080@(1–25/30 fps) *The values above are the max. frame rates of each stream; for multiple streams, the values will be subjected to the total encoding capacity.
General.Video Bit Rate: H.264: 3 kbps–8192 kbps H.265: 3 kbps–8192 kbps
General.White Balance: Auto; natural; street lamp; outdoor; manual; regional custom
General.Alarm Event: No SD card; SD card full; SD card error; network disconnection; IP conflict; voltage detection; illegal access; motion detection; video tampering; scene changing; audio detection; tripwire; intrusion; fast moving; abandoned object; missing object; loitering detection; people gathering; parking detection; crossing warning line; warning area intrusion; running detection; abnormal number of people detection; fall detection; people approaching detection; violence detection; people stay detection
General.Network Protocol: IPv4; IPv6; HTTP; TCP; UDP; ARP; RTP ; RTSP; RTCP; RTMP; SMTP; FTP; SFTP; DHCP; DNS; DDNS; QoS; UPnP; NTP; Multicast; ICMP; IGMP; NFS; PPPoE; SNMP; auto registration
General.Interoperability: ONVIF (Profile S; Profile G; Profile T); P2P; CGI
General.Storage: FTP; SFTP; Micro SD card (support max. 512 GB); NAS
General.Browser: IE: IE 9 and later Chrome: Chrome 41 and later Firefox: Firefox 50 and later Safari: Safari 10 and later
General.Security: Trusted execution;Session security;Digest;Security logs;WSSE;Account lockout;Security warning;syslog;802.1x;IP/MAC filtering;HTTPS;Trusted upgrade;Trusted boot;Generation and importing of X.509 certification
General.Certifications: CE-LVD: EN62368-1 CE-EMC: Electromagnetic Compatibility Directive 2014/30/EU
General.Alarm Input: 2 channels in: wet contact, 5 mA 3–5 VDC
General.Power Output: 12 VDC power output, max. current 165 mA, peak current 700 mA
General.Power Consumption: Basic: 5.9 W (12 VDC), 7 W (PoE); Max. (intelligence on + IR intensity + turn on the speaker+ power output): 10.8 W (12 VDC), 12.9 W (PoE)
